transactionallyRejectedPreflights: The first owner-dividend migration attempt lacked CREATE authority in backend_system. PostgreSQL rejected the transaction before commit; the exact migration was corrected to grant and revoke bounded authority through ledger_store_owner.

The second owner-dividend migration attempt lacked corporate_governance_store_owner access to extensions.digest. PostgreSQL rejected the transaction before commit; the exact migration was corrected with narrow schema USAGE and digest(text,text) EXECUTE grants.
apply.rollback: The exact rollback chain is present, statically parsed and covered by capability-schema tests. It was deliberately not executed against the owner-designated hosted target because rollback is destructive and the canonical store contains zero business rows.
